```csharp
            if (btnTpGreenhouse != null) btnTpGreenhouse.onClick.AddListener(() => TeleportTo("Spawn_Greenhouse"));
            if (btnTpVillage != null) btnTpVillage.onClick.AddListener(() => TeleportTo("Spawn_Village"));
            if (btnTpGarden != null) btnTpGarden.onClick.AddListener(() => TeleportTo("Spawn_BachGarden"));
            if (btnTpForest != null) btnTpForest.onClick.AddListener(() => TeleportTo("Spawn_ForestEdge"));
            if (btnTimePlus2H != null) btnTimePlus2H.onClick.AddListener(() => { GameRoot.Instance?.Time?.AddHours(2f); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnTimeSetDusk != null) btnTimeSetDusk.onClick.AddListener(() => { GameRoot.Instance?.Time?.SetHour(19.83f); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnTimeNextDay != null) btnTimeNextDay.onClick.AddListener(() => { GameRoot.Instance?.Time?.AdvanceToNextDay(); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnRestoreStats != null) btnRestoreStats.onClick.AddListener(() => { GameRoot.Instance?.Stats?.RestoreStats(100, 100, true); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnForceExhaust != null) btnForceExhaust.onClick.AddListener(() => { GameRoot.Instance?.Stats?.ConsumeStamina(999, true); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnDamageLightHP != null) btnDamageLightHP.onClick.AddListener(() => { GameRoot.Instance?.Stats?.TakeLightDamage(25, true); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnGiveTestKit != null) btnGiveTestKit.onClick.AddListener(OnClickGiveTestKit);
            if (btnWaterAllCrops != null) btnWaterAllCrops.onClick.AddListener(() => { FarmGridManager.Instance?.WaterAllTilesDebug(); RefreshStatusText(); });
            if (btnSkipPrologue != null) btnSkipPrologue.onClick.AddListener(OnClickSkipPrologue);
            if (btnGiveSickle != null) btnGiveSickle.onClick.AddListener(OnClickGiveSickle);
            if (btnPrepClimax != null) btnPrepClimax.onClick.AddListener(OnClickPrepClimax);

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnStoryFlagChanged += OnAnyStateUpdated;
            GameEventBus.OnGameStateChanged += OnGameStateUpdated;

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnStoryFlagChanged -= OnAnyStateUpdated;
            GameEventBus.OnGameStateChanged -= OnGameStateUpdated;
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!Application.isEditor && !Debug.isDebugBuild) return;
            if (WasF1PressedThisFrame()) TogglePanel();

            if (_isOpen)
            {
                _refreshTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                if (_refreshTimer >= 0.25f) { _refreshTimer = 0f; RefreshStatusText(); }
            }
        }

        {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM

#endif
#if ENABLE_LEGACY_INPUT_MANAGER
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.F1)) return true;
#endif
            return false;
        }

            f.SetFlag("flag_greenhouse_cleared", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_lumi_awakened", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_solo_plant_failed", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_tutorial_done", true);

            OnClickSkipPrologue();
            var f = GameRoot.Instance.Flags;
            f.SetFlag("flag_met_bach_at_gate", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_garden_slimes_cleared", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_garden_bench_cleaned", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_hana_bread_done", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_toby_cat_slimes_cleared", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_toby_cat_saved", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_otis_mailbox_fixed", true);
            f.SetFlag("flag_bach_letters_read", true);

            var inv = GameRoot.Instance.Inventory;
            if (inv != null)

                if (!inv.HasItem("item_seed_bag_1", 1)) inv.AddItemById("item_seed_bag_1", 1, false);
                if (!inv.HasItem("item_seed_bag_2", 1)) inv.AddItemById("item_seed_bag_2", 1, false);
                if (!inv.HasItem("item_seed_bag_3", 1)) inv.AddItemById("item_seed_bag_3", 1, false);
                if (inv.GetItemCount("item_dew_sap") < 5) inv.AddItemById("item_dew_sap", 5, false);
                if (inv.GetItemCount("item_starlight_dust") < 3) inv.AddItemById("item_starlight_dust", 3, false);
            }

            TeleportTo("Spawn_BachGarden");
            GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Đã gọi đủ 4 Helpers & cấp đủ đồ Bundle! Hãy tới Bồn Hoa bấm [E]!");
            RefreshStatusText();
        }

        private void OnClickTogglePause()
        {
            if (GameRoot.Instance == null || GameRoot.Instance.State == null) return;
            var next = GameRoot.Instance.State.IsGameplayActive ? GameState.PauseMenu : GameState.Gameplay;
            GameRoot.Instance.State.SetState(next);
            RefreshStatusText();
        }

        private void OnAnyStateUpdated(string _, bool __) => RefreshStatusText();
        private void OnGameStateUpdated(GameState _) => RefreshStatusText();

        public void RefreshStatusText()
        {
            if (statusText == null || GameRoot.Instance == null) return;
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendLine("<b>BẢNG DEBUG MOONPETAL (F1)</b>");
            if (GameRoot.Instance.Time != null) sb.AppendLine(GameRoot.Instance.Time.GetFormattedClockString());
            if (GameRoot.Instance.Bundle != null)
            {
                sb.AppendLine("Helpers: " + GameRoot.Instance.Bundle.GetReadyHelperCount() + "/4 | Bundle: " +
                              (GameRoot.Instance.Bundle.IsBundleItemsComplete() ? "ĐỦ" : "CHƯA"));
            }
            statusText.text = sb.ToString();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Farming
{
    public class FarmGridManager : MonoBehaviour, ISaveable
    {
        public static FarmGridManager Instance { get; private set; }

        [SerializeField] private List<FarmTileController> tiles = new List<FarmTileController>();
        [SerializeField] private CropData defaultCropData;

        public string SaveKey => "farm_tiles";

        [Serializable]
        private struct SavedTile
        {
            public string id;
            public int state;
            public string cropId;
            public int stage;
            public bool watered;
        }

        [Serializable]
        private class FarmSaveWrapper
        {
            public List<SavedTile> savedTiles = new List<SavedTile>();
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            Instance = this;
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnDayStarted += HandleDayStarted;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnDayStarted -= HandleDayStarted;
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.RegisterSaveable(this);
            }
        }

        private void HandleDayStarted(int newDay)
        {
            int readyCount = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (tiles[i] != null)
                {
                    tiles[i].OnNewDay();
                    if (tiles[i].IsReadyToHarvest) readyCount++;
                }
            }
            if (readyCount > 0)
            {
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Trong Nhà Kính có " + readyCount + " cây Lúa Mạch Sương Mai đã chín! Bấm [E] để thu hoạch.");
            }
        }

        public FarmTileController FindClosestTile(Vector2 worldPos, float maxDistance = 1.15f)
        {
            FarmTileController best = null;
            float bestDist = maxDistance;
            for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (tiles[i] == null) continue;
                float d = Vector2.Distance(worldPos, tiles[i].transform.position);
                if (d < bestDist)
                {
                    bestDist = d;
                    best = tiles[i];
                }
            }
            return best;
        }

        public int CountPlantedCrops(string cropId)
        {
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (tiles[i] != null && tiles[i].State == FarmTileState.Planted &&
                    tiles[i].PlantedCrop != null && tiles[i].PlantedCrop.cropID == cropId)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            return count;
        }

        public void WaterAllTilesDebug()
        {
            int watered = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (tiles[i] != null && tiles[i].State != FarmTileState.Untilled)
                {
                    tiles[i].ForceWaterDebug();
                    watered++;
                }
            }
            GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Đã tưới nước toàn bộ " + watered + " ô đất đã cuốc!");
        }

        public string CaptureStateJson()
        {
            var wrapper = new FarmSaveWrapper();
            for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (tiles[i] == null) continue;
                wrapper.savedTiles.Add(new SavedTile
                {
                    id = tiles[i].TileId,
                    state = (int)tiles[i].State,
                    cropId = tiles[i].PlantedCrop != null ? tiles[i].PlantedCrop.cropID : "",
                    stage = tiles[i].GrowthStage,
                    watered = tiles[i].IsWatered
                });
            }
            return JsonUtility.ToJson(wrapper);
        }

        public void RestoreStateJson(string json)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json)) return;
            var wrapper = JsonUtility.FromJson<FarmSaveWrapper>(json);
            if (wrapper == null || wrapper.savedTiles == null) return;

            for (int i = 0; i < wrapper.savedTiles.Count; i++)
            {
                var st = wrapper.savedTiles[i];
                for (int j = 0; j < tiles.Count; j++)
                {
                    if (tiles[j] != null && tiles[j].TileId == st.id)
                    {
                        CropData crop = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(st.cropId) ? defaultCropData : null;
                        tiles[j].RestoreState((FarmTileState)st.state, crop, st.stage, st.watered);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    
        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null) GameRoot.Instance.UnregisterSaveable(this);
        }
}
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Farming
{
    public enum FarmTileState
    {
        Untilled,
        TilledDry,
        Planted
    }

    public class FarmTileController : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private string tileId;
        [SerializeField] private SpriteRenderer soilRenderer;
        [SerializeField] private SpriteRenderer cropRenderer;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite untilledSprite;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite tilledDrySprite;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite tilledWetSprite;

        public string TileId => tileId;
        public FarmTileState State { get; private set; } = FarmTileState.Untilled;
        public CropData PlantedCrop { get; private set; }
        public int GrowthStage { get; private set; }
        public bool IsWatered { get; private set; }

        public bool IsReadyToHarvest => State == FarmTileState.Planted && PlantedCrop != null && GrowthStage >= PlantedCrop.growDays;

        private void Start()
        {
            RefreshVisuals();
        }

        public bool TryTill()
        {
            if (State != FarmTileState.Untilled) return false;
            State = FarmTileState.TilledDry;
            IsWatered = false;
            RefreshVisuals();
            return true;
        }

        public bool TryPlant(CropData crop)
        {
            if (crop == null || State != FarmTileState.TilledDry) return false;
            State = FarmTileState.Planted;
            PlantedCrop = crop;
            GrowthStage = 0;
            RefreshVisuals();
            return true;
        }

        public bool TryWater()
        {
            if (State == FarmTileState.Untilled || IsWatered) return false;
            IsWatered = true;
            RefreshVisuals();
            return true;
        }

        public bool TryHarvest(out ItemData harvestedItem, out int yieldAmount)
        {
            harvestedItem = null;
            yieldAmount = 0;
            if (!IsReadyToHarvest) return false;

            harvestedItem = PlantedCrop.harvestedItem;
            yieldAmount = Mathf.Max(1, PlantedCrop.harvestYield);

            State = FarmTileState.TilledDry;
            PlantedCrop = null;
            GrowthStage = 0;
            IsWatered = false;
            RefreshVisuals();
            return true;
        }

        public void OnNewDay()
        {
            if (State == FarmTileState.Planted && PlantedCrop != null)
            {
                if (IsWatered && GrowthStage < PlantedCrop.growDays)
                {
                    GrowthStage++;
                }
            }
            IsWatered = false;
            RefreshVisuals();
        }

        public void ForceWaterDebug()
        {
            if (State != FarmTileState.Untilled)
            {
                IsWatered = true;
                RefreshVisuals();
            }
        }

        public void RestoreState(FarmTileState state, CropData crop, int stage, bool watered)
        {
            State = state;
            PlantedCrop = crop;
            GrowthStage = stage;
            IsWatered = watered;
            RefreshVisuals();
        }

        public void RefreshVisuals()
        {
            if (soilRenderer != null)
            {
                if (State == FarmTileState.Untilled) soilRenderer.sprite = untilledSprite;
                else soilRenderer.sprite = IsWatered ? tilledWetSprite : tilledDrySprite;
            }

            if (cropRenderer != null)
            {
                if (State == FarmTileState.Planted && PlantedCrop != null && PlantedCrop.stageSprites != null && PlantedCrop.stageSprites.Length > 0)
                {
                    int maxIdx = PlantedCrop.stageSprites.Length - 1;
                    int idx = IsReadyToHarvest
                        ? maxIdx
                        : Mathf.Clamp(GrowthStage, 0, Mathf.Max(0, maxIdx - 1));
                    cropRenderer.sprite = PlantedCrop.stageSprites[idx];
                    cropRenderer.enabled = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    cropRenderer.sprite = null;
                    cropRenderer.enabled = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 41. `Assets/Scripts/Farming/ResourceNodeController.cs`

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;
using MoonpetalValley.Inventory;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Farming
{
    public enum ResourceNodeType
    {
        DryBranch,
        GreenhouseDebris
    }

    public class ResourceNodeController : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private ResourceNodeType nodeType = ResourceNodeType.DryBranch;
        [SerializeField] private string requiredToolId = "item_hatchet";
        [SerializeField] private int maxHits = 2;
        [SerializeField] private ItemData dropItem;
        [SerializeField] private int dropAmount = 2;
        [SerializeField] private GameObject lootDropPrefab;
        [SerializeField] private bool regrowEachDay = true;
        [SerializeField] private SpriteRenderer visualRenderer;
        [SerializeField] private Collider2D nodeCollider;

        private int _currentHits;
        private bool _isDepleted;
        private float _shakeTimer;
        private Vector3 _baseLocalPos;

        public bool IsDepleted => _isDepleted;
        public ResourceNodeType NodeType => nodeType;

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (visualRenderer != null) _baseLocalPos = visualRenderer.transform.localPosition;
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnDayStarted += HandleDayStarted;
            GameEventBus.OnSaveLoaded += SyncWithStoryFlags;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnDayStarted -= HandleDayStarted;
            GameEventBus.OnSaveLoaded -= SyncWithStoryFlags;
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            SyncWithStoryFlags();
        }

        public void SyncWithStoryFlags()
        {
            if (nodeType != ResourceNodeType.GreenhouseDebris) return;
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Flags != null &&
                GameRoot.Instance.Flags.HasFlag("flag_greenhouse_cleared"))
            {
                _isDepleted = true;
                if (visualRenderer != null) visualRenderer.enabled = false;
                if (nodeCollider != null) nodeCollider.enabled = false;
            }
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (_shakeTimer > 0f && visualRenderer != null)
            {
                _shakeTimer -= Time.deltaTime;
                float offset = Mathf.Sin(_shakeTimer * 55f) * 0.08f;
                visualRenderer.transform.localPosition = _baseLocalPos + new Vector3(offset, 0f, 0f);
                if (_shakeTimer <= 0f)
                {
                    visualRenderer.transform.localPosition = _baseLocalPos;
                }
            }
        }

        private void HandleDayStarted(int day)
        {
            if (regrowEachDay && _isDepleted)
            {
                RestoreNode();
            }
        }

        public bool TryHit(string toolId)
        {
            if (_isDepleted) return false;

            bool validTool = toolId == requiredToolId ||
                             (nodeType == ResourceNodeType.GreenhouseDebris && (toolId == "item_hoe" || toolId == "item_hatchet"));
            if (!validTool)
            {
                string needed = requiredToolId == "item_hatchet" ? "Rìu Nhỏ (phím 3)" : "Cuốc Đất (phím 1)";
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Cần dùng " + needed + " để dọn vật thể này!");
                return false;
            }

            _currentHits++;
            _shakeTimer = 0.22f;

            if (_currentHits >= maxHits)
            {
                DepleteNode();
            }
            return true;
        }

        private void DepleteNode()
        {
            _isDepleted = true;
            if (visualRenderer != null) visualRenderer.enabled = false;
            if (nodeCollider != null) nodeCollider.enabled = false;

            if (dropItem != null && dropAmount > 0)
            {
                if (lootDropPrefab != null)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < dropAmount; i++)
                    {
                        Vector2 offset = new Vector2(Random.Range(-0.35f, 0.35f), Random.Range(-0.25f, 0.25f));
                        GameObject go = Instantiate(lootDropPrefab, transform.position + (Vector3)offset, Quaternion.identity);
                        var drop = go.GetComponent<WorldLootDrop>();
                        if (drop != null) drop.Initialize(dropItem, 1);
                    }
                }
                else if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Inventory != null)
                {
                    GameRoot.Instance.Inventory.AddItem(dropItem, dropAmount, true);
                }
            }

            if (nodeType == ResourceNodeType.GreenhouseDebris)
            {
                CheckAllGreenhouseDebrisCleared();
            }
        }

        private void CheckAllGreenhouseDebrisCleared()
        {
            var allNodes = UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<ResourceNodeController>(FindObjectsInactive.Include);
            int remaining = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < allNodes.Length; i++)
            {
                if (allNodes[i].NodeType == ResourceNodeType.GreenhouseDebris && !allNodes[i].IsDepleted)
                {
                    remaining++;
                }
            }

            if (remaining == 0 && GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Flags != null)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Flags.SetFlag("flag_greenhouse_cleared", true);
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Đã dọn sạch cỏ dại & đá vụn trong Nhà Kính!");
            }
        }

        public void RestoreNode()
        {
            _isDepleted = false;
            _currentHits = 0;
            if (visualRenderer != null) visualRenderer.enabled = true;
            if (nodeCollider != null) nodeCollider.enabled = true;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Farming
{
    public class SeedShelfInteractable : MonoBehaviour, IInteractable
    {
        [SerializeField] private GameObject promptObject;
        [SerializeField] private float interactRadius = 1.9f;

        public bool CanInteract => gameObject.activeInHierarchy;
        public float InteractRadius => interactRadius;
        public Vector2 InteractionWorldPosition => transform.position;
        public Vector3 PointerAnchorPosition => new Vector3(transform.position.x, transform.position.y + 0.9f, 0f);
        public string InteractionPromptLabel => "Lấy Hạt Giống Dự Phòng";

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            InteractionManager.Register(this);
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            InteractionManager.Unregister(this);
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            HideLegacyPrompt();
        }

        public void HideLegacyPrompt()
        {
            if (promptObject != null && promptObject.activeSelf) promptObject.SetActive(false);
        }

        public void Interact()
        {
            TryGiveBackupSeeds();
        }

        private void TryGiveBackupSeeds()
        {
            if (GameRoot.Instance == null || GameRoot.Instance.Inventory == null) return;
            var inv = GameRoot.Instance.Inventory;

            int seedsInBag = inv.GetItemCount("item_dew_barley_seed");
            int cropsInBag = inv.GetItemCount("item_dew_barley");
            int planted = FarmGridManager.Instance != null ? FarmGridManager.Instance.CountPlantedCrops("crop_dew_barley") : 0;
            int total = seedsInBag + cropsInBag + planted;

            if (total >= 6)
            {
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Bạn đã có đủ Hạt/Cây Lúa Mạch Sương Mai rồi (" + total + "/6).");
                return;
            }

            int give = 6 - total;
            inv.AddItemById("item_dew_barley_seed", give, true);
        }
    }
}
```

## 44. `Assets/Scripts/Inventory/InventoryManager.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;
using MoonpetalValley.TimeSystem;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Inventory
{
    [Serializable]
    public class InventorySlot
    {
        public ItemData item;
        public int amount;

        public bool IsEmpty => item == null || amount <= 0;
    }

    public class InventoryManager : MonoBehaviour, ISaveable, IResettable
    {
        public const int TotalSlots = 16;
        public const int HotbarSize = 8;
        public const int MaxWaterCharges = 20;

        [SerializeField] private ItemDatabaseSO itemDatabase;

        public event Action OnInventoryChanged;
        public event Action<int> OnSelectedSlotChanged;

        private readonly InventorySlot[] _slots = new InventorySlot[TotalSlots];
        public int SelectedHotbarIndex { get; private set; }
        public int WateringCanCharges { get; private set; } = MaxWaterCharges;

        public string SaveKey => "inventory";

        [Serializable]
        private struct SavedSlot
        {
            public int index;
            public string itemId;
            public int amount;
        }

        [Serializable]
        private class InventorySaveData
        {
            public int selectedIndex;
            public int waterCharges;
            public List<SavedSlot> slots = new List<SavedSlot>();
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                _slots[i] = new InventorySlot();
            }
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            SleepAndKnockoutController.OnPassOutMaterialPenalty += ApplyPassOutMaterialDrop;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            SleepAndKnockoutController.OnPassOutMaterialPenalty -= ApplyPassOutMaterialDrop;
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            // Khởi tạo 3 nông cụ cơ bản nếu túi đang trống hoàn toàn
            if (IsCompletelyEmpty())
            {
                AddItemById("item_hoe", 1, false);
                AddItemById("item_watering_can", 1, false);
                AddItemById("item_hatchet", 1, false);
                SelectHotbarSlot(0);
            }
        }

        public bool IsCompletelyEmpty()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                if (!_slots[i].IsEmpty) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public InventorySlot GetSlot(int index)
        {
            if (index < 0 || index >= TotalSlots) return null;
            return _slots[index];
        }

        public InventorySlot GetSelectedSlot() => _slots[SelectedHotbarIndex];

        public ItemData GetItemDataById(string itemId)
        {
            return itemDatabase != null ? itemDatabase.GetById(itemId) : null;
        }

        public void SelectHotbarSlot(int index)
        {
            int clamped = Mathf.Clamp(index, 0, HotbarSize - 1);
            SelectedHotbarIndex = clamped;
            OnSelectedSlotChanged?.Invoke(SelectedHotbarIndex);
            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
        }

        public void CycleHotbar(int delta)
        {
            int next = (SelectedHotbarIndex + delta) % HotbarSize;
            if (next < 0) next += HotbarSize;
            SelectHotbarSlot(next);
        }

        public bool SwapOrMergeSlots(int fromIndex, int toIndex)
        {
            if (fromIndex < 0 || fromIndex >= TotalSlots || toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= TotalSlots) return false;
            if (fromIndex == toIndex) return false;

            InventorySlot fromSlot = _slots[fromIndex];
            InventorySlot toSlot = _slots[toIndex];
            if (fromSlot.IsEmpty && toSlot.IsEmpty) return false;

            // Tự động gộp stack nếu 2 ô chứa cùng loại vật phẩm có thể cộng dồn
            if (!fromSlot.IsEmpty && !toSlot.IsEmpty &&
                fromSlot.item.itemID == toSlot.item.itemID &&
                toSlot.item.maxStack > 1 &&
                toSlot.amount < toSlot.item.maxStack)
            {
                int space = toSlot.item.maxStack - toSlot.amount;
                int moveAmt = Mathf.Min(space, fromSlot.amount);
                toSlot.amount += moveAmt;
                fromSlot.amount -= moveAmt;
                if (fromSlot.amount <= 0)
                {
                    fromSlot.item = null;
                    fromSlot.amount = 0;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                ItemData tmpItem = toSlot.item;
                int tmpAmount = toSlot.amount;

                toSlot.item = fromSlot.item;
                toSlot.amount = fromSlot.amount;

                fromSlot.item = tmpItem;
                fromSlot.amount = tmpAmount;
            }

            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
            return true;
        }

        public bool AddItemById(string itemId, int amount = 1, bool showToast = true)
        {
            ItemData data = GetItemDataById(itemId);
            if (data == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("[MV] Không tìm thấy ItemData với ID: " + itemId);
                return false;
            }
            return AddItem(data, amount, showToast);
        }

        public bool AddItem(ItemData data, int amount = 1, bool showToast = true)
        {
            if (data == null || amount <= 0) return false;

            int remaining = amount;

            if (data.maxStack > 1)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots && remaining > 0; i++)
                {
                    if (!_slots[i].IsEmpty && _slots[i].item.itemID == data.itemID && _slots[i].amount < data.maxStack)
                    {
                        int add = Mathf.Min(remaining, data.maxStack - _slots[i].amount);
                        _slots[i].amount += add;
                        remaining -= add;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots && remaining > 0; i++)
            {
                if (_slots[i].IsEmpty)
                {
                    int add = Mathf.Min(remaining, Mathf.Max(1, data.maxStack));
                    _slots[i].item = data;
                    _slots[i].amount = add;
                    remaining -= add;
                }
            }

            int added = amount - remaining;
            if (added > 0)
            {
                OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
                GameEventBus.RaiseItemChanged(data.itemID, GetItemCount(data.itemID));
                if (showToast)
                {
                    string itemName = GetLocalizedItemName(data);
                    GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested(string.Format("Nhận +{0} {1}", added, itemName));
                }
            }
            return remaining == 0;
        }

        public bool RemoveItem(string itemId, int amount = 1)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemId) || amount <= 0) return false;
            if (GetItemCount(itemId) < amount) return false;

            int remaining = amount;
            for (int i = TotalSlots - 1; i >= 0 && remaining > 0; i--)
            {
                if (!_slots[i].IsEmpty && _slots[i].item.itemID == itemId)
                {
                    int take = Mathf.Min(remaining, _slots[i].amount);
                    _slots[i].amount -= take;
                    remaining -= take;
                    if (_slots[i].amount <= 0)
                    {
                        _slots[i].item = null;
                        _slots[i].amount = 0;
                    }
                }
            }

            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
            GameEventBus.RaiseItemChanged(itemId, GetItemCount(itemId));
            return true;
        }

        public int GetItemCount(string itemId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemId)) return 0;
            int total = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                if (!_slots[i].IsEmpty && _slots[i].item.itemID == itemId)
                {
                    total += _slots[i].amount;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }

        public bool HasItem(string itemId, int amount = 1) => GetItemCount(itemId) >= amount;

        public bool UseSelectedConsumable()
        {
            var slot = GetSelectedSlot();
            if (slot == null || slot.IsEmpty || slot.item.category != ItemCategory.Consumable)
            {
                return false;
            }

            ItemData food = slot.item;
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Stats != null)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Stats.RestoreStats(food.staminaRestore, food.lightHPRestore, food.clearsExhaustionPenalty);
            }

            RemoveItem(food.itemID, 1);
            string foodName = GetLocalizedItemName(food);
            string extra = food.clearsExhaustionPenalty ? " & xóa phạt kiệt sức!" : "!";
            GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested(string.Format("Đã ăn {0}: +{1} Thể lực, +{2} Máu Ánh Sáng{3}",
                foodName, food.staminaRestore, food.lightHPRestore, extra));
            return true;
        }

        public bool ConsumeWaterCharge()
        {
            if (WateringCanCharges <= 0)
            {
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Bình Tưới đã hết nước! Hãy ra Giếng Nước bấm [E] để múc đầy.");
                return false;
            }
            WateringCanCharges--;
            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
            return true;
        }

        public void RefillWateringCan()
        {
            WateringCanCharges = MaxWaterCharges;
            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
            GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Đã múc đầy Bình Tưới (20/20).");
        }

        public string GetLocalizedItemName(ItemData data)
        {
            if (data == null) return string.Empty;
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Loc != null)
            {
                return GameRoot.Instance.Loc.Get(data.displayNameKey);
            }
            return data.itemID;
        }

        public string GetLocalizedItemDesc(ItemData data)
        {
            if (data == null) return string.Empty;
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Loc != null)
            {
                return GameRoot.Instance.Loc.Get(data.descriptionKey);
            }
            return string.Empty;
        }

        private void ApplyPassOutMaterialDrop()
        {
            int totalDropped = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                var slot = _slots[i];
                if (slot.IsEmpty || slot.item.isQuestProtected) continue;
                if (slot.amount < 5) continue;

                int dropCount = Mathf.Max(1, Mathf.FloorToInt(slot.amount * 0.10f));
                slot.amount -= dropCount;
                totalDropped += dropCount;
                if (slot.amount <= 0)
                {
                    slot.item = null;
                    slot.amount = 0;
                }
            }

            if (totalDropped > 0)
            {
                OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
                Debug.Log("[MV] Ngất xỉu làm rơi " + totalDropped + " nguyên liệu thường (vật phẩm nhiệm vụ được bảo vệ).");
            }
        }

        public string CaptureStateJson()
        {
            var data = new InventorySaveData
            {
                selectedIndex = SelectedHotbarIndex,
                waterCharges = WateringCanCharges
            };
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                if (!_slots[i].IsEmpty)
                {
                    data.slots.Add(new SavedSlot
                    {
                        index = i,
                        itemId = _slots[i].item.itemID,
                        amount = _slots[i].amount
                    });
                }
            }
            return JsonUtility.ToJson(data);
        }

        public void RestoreStateJson(string json)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                _slots[i].item = null;
                _slots[i].amount = 0;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json)) return;

            var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<InventorySaveData>(json);
            if (data == null) return;

            SelectedHotbarIndex = Mathf.Clamp(data.selectedIndex, 0, HotbarSize - 1);
            WateringCanCharges = Mathf.Clamp(data.waterCharges, 0, MaxWaterCharges);

            if (data.slots != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < data.slots.Count; i++)
                {
                    var s = data.slots[i];
                    if (s.index >= 0 && s.index < TotalSlots)
                    {
                        _slots[s.index].item = GetItemDataById(s.itemId);
                        _slots[s.index].amount = s.amount;
                    }
                }
            }
            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
        }
    
        public void ResetForNewGame()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < TotalSlots; i++)
            {
                _slots[i].item = null;
                _slots[i].amount = 0;
            }
            WateringCanCharges = MaxWaterCharges;
            AddItemById("item_hoe", 1, false);
            AddItemById("item_watering_can", 1, false);
            AddItemById("item_hatchet", 1, false);
            SelectHotbarSlot(0);
            OnInventoryChanged?.Invoke();
        }
}
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;
using MoonpetalValley.Player;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Inventory
{
    public class WorldLootDrop : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private ItemData itemData;
        [SerializeField] private int amount = 1;
        [SerializeField] private SpriteRenderer spriteRenderer;

        private PlayerController2D _player;
        private float _bobPhase;
        private float _spawnLockTimer = 0.25f;

        public void Initialize(ItemData data, int count)
        {
            itemData = data;
            amount = Mathf.Max(1, count);
            if (spriteRenderer != null && itemData != null && itemData.icon != null)
            {
                spriteRenderer.sprite = itemData.icon;
            }
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            _bobPhase = Random.Range(0f, 6.28f);
            if (spriteRenderer != null && itemData != null && itemData.icon != null)
            {
                spriteRenderer.sprite = itemData.icon;
            }
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (_spawnLockTimer > 0f) _spawnLockTimer -= Time.deltaTime;

            _bobPhase += Time.deltaTime * 5f;
            if (spriteRenderer != null)
            {
                spriteRenderer.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, Mathf.Sin(_bobPhase) * 0.08f, 0f);
            }

            if (_spawnLockTimer > 0f) return;

            if (_player == null)
            {
                _player = UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<PlayerController2D>();
                if (_player == null) return;
            }

            float dist = Vector2.Distance(transform.position, _player.transform.position);
            if (dist <= 2.3f)
            {
                transform.position = Vector3.MoveTowards(transform.position, _player.transform.position, Time.deltaTime * 7.5f);
            }
            if (dist <= 0.55f)
            {
                if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Inventory != null && itemData != null)
                {
                    if (GameRoot.Instance.Inventory.AddItem(itemData, amount, true))
                    {
                        Destroy(gameObject);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 46. `Assets/Scripts/Narrative/DialogueManager.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;
using MoonpetalValley.Player;
using MoonpetalValley.UI;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Narrative
{
    public class DialogueManager : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private DialogueUIView dialogueUI;

        [Header("Character Standing Portraits")]
        [SerializeField] private Sprite portraitWen;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite portraitLumi;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite portraitBach;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite portraitHana;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite portraitToby;
        [SerializeField] private Sprite portraitOtis;

        private struct RuntimeLine
        {
            public string speaker;
            public string body;
            public string speakerId;
            public Sprite portraitOverride;
        }

        private readonly List<RuntimeLine> _queue = new List<RuntimeLine>();
        private readonly List<string> _recentLog = new List<string>();
        private const int MaxLogEntries = 10;

        private int _currentIndex;
        private DialogueData _activeAsset;
        private Action _onFinishCallback;
        private bool _isPlaying;
        private float _inputLockTimer;
        private GameInputReader _input;

        public bool IsDialogueActive => _isPlaying;
        public IReadOnlyList<string> RecentLog => _recentLog;

        public void StartDialogue(DialogueData data, Action onFinish = null)
        {
            if (data == null || data.lines == null || data.lines.Count == 0) return;

            var flags = GameRoot.Instance?.Flags;
            _queue.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < data.lines.Count; i++)
            {
                var line = data.lines[i];
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(line.requiredFlag) && (flags == null || !flags.HasFlag(line.requiredFlag))) continue;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(line.blockedFlag) && flags != null && flags.HasFlag(line.blockedFlag)) continue;

                _queue.Add(new RuntimeLine
                {
                    speaker = ResolveText(line.speakerNameKey),
                    body = ResolveText(line.textKey),
                    speakerId = line.speakerId,
                    portraitOverride = line.portraitOverride
                });
            }

            if (_queue.Count == 0) return;

            _activeAsset = data;
            _onFinishCallback = onFinish;
            BeginDisplay(clearPortraits: true);
        }

        public void StartQuickDialogue(string speaker, string body, Action onFinish = null)
        {
            StartQuickLines(new[] { (speaker, body) }, onFinish);
        }

        public void StartQuickLines((string speaker, string body)[] lines, Action onFinish = null)
        {
            if (lines == null || lines.Length == 0) return;
            _queue.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
            {
                _queue.Add(new RuntimeLine
                {
                    speaker = lines[i].speaker,
                    body = lines[i].body,
                    speakerId = "",
                    portraitOverride = null
                });
            }
            _activeAsset = null;
            _onFinishCallback = onFinish;
            BeginDisplay(clearPortraits: true);
        }

        private void BeginDisplay(bool clearPortraits)
        {
            _currentIndex = 0;
            _isPlaying = true;
            _inputLockTimer = 0.16f;

            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.State != null)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.State.SetState(GameState.Dialogue);
            }

            if (clearPortraits && dialogueUI != null)
            {
                dialogueUI.Hide();
            }

            ShowCurrentLine(keepOtherSide: false);
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!_isPlaying) return;
            if (_inputLockTimer > 0f)
            {
                _inputLockTimer -= Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                return;
            }

            // Phim L mo/dong Nhat ky 10 cau hoi thoai gan nhat
            if (WasLogKeyPressed())
            {
                dialogueUI?.ToggleLog(_recentLog);
                _inputLockTimer = 0.14f;
                return;
            }

            if (dialogueUI != null && dialogueUI.IsLogOpen)
            {
                if (_input != null && (_input.PausePressed || _input.InteractPressed))
                {
                    dialogueUI.CloseLog();
                    _inputLockTimer = 0.14f;
                }
                return;
            }

            if (_input == null)
            {
                var p = UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<PlayerController2D>();
                if (p != null) _input = p.GetComponent<GameInputReader>();
            }

            if (dialogueUI != null && dialogueUI.IsShowingChoices)
            {
                if (_input != null && _input.HotbarSlotPressed == 0) dialogueUI.PickChoice(0);
                else if (_input != null && _input.HotbarSlotPressed == 1) dialogueUI.PickChoice(1);
                return;
            }

            bool advance = _input != null && (_input.InteractPressed || _input.DashPressed || _input.ActionPressed);
            if (advance)
            {
                if (dialogueUI != null && dialogueUI.IsTyping)
                {
                    dialogueUI.CompleteTypewriterImmediate();
                    _inputLockTimer = 0.10f;
                    return;
                }

                _currentIndex++;
                if (_currentIndex >= _queue.Count)
                {
                    if (_activeAsset != null && _activeAsset.choices != null && _activeAsset.choices.Count > 0)
                    {
                        PresentChoices(_activeAsset);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        FinishDialogue();
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    _inputLockTimer = 0.10f;
                    ShowCurrentLine(keepOtherSide: true);
                }
            }
        }

        private bool WasLogKeyPressed()
        {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
            if (UnityEngine.InputSystem.Keyboard.current != null && UnityEngine.InputSystem.Keyboard.current.lKey.wasPressedThisFrame)
                return true;
#elif ENABLE_LEGACY_INPUT_MANAGER
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.L)) return true;
#endif
            return false;
        }

        private void ShowCurrentLine(bool keepOtherSide)
        {
            if (dialogueUI == null || _currentIndex < 0 || _currentIndex >= _queue.Count) return;
            var line = _queue[_currentIndex];
            ResolvePortrait(line.speaker, line.speakerId, line.portraitOverride, out Sprite portrait, out bool alignLeft, out bool isFloating, out string voiceId);
            bool isLast = (_currentIndex == _queue.Count - 1) && (_activeAsset == null || _activeAsset.choices == null || _activeAsset.choices.Count == 0);

            RecordLog(line.speaker, line.body);
            dialogueUI.ShowLine(line.speaker, line.body, portrait, alignLeft, isFloating, isLast, voiceId, keepOtherSide);
        }

        private void RecordLog(string speaker, string body)
        {
            string entry = string.IsNullOrEmpty(speaker) ? body : ("<b>" + speaker + ":</b> " + body);
            _recentLog.Add(entry);
            while (_recentLog.Count > MaxLogEntries) _recentLog.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        private void PresentChoices(DialogueData asset)
        {
            if (dialogueUI == null) { FinishDialogue(); return; }
            string a = asset.choices.Count > 0 ? ResolveText(asset.choices[0].choiceTextKey) : "";
            string b = asset.choices.Count > 1 ? ResolveText(asset.choices[1].choiceTextKey) : "";

            dialogueUI.ShowChoices(a, b, idx =>
            {
                if (idx >= 0 && idx < asset.choices.Count)
                {
                    var picked = asset.choices[idx];
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(picked.setsFlagOnPick))
                        GameRoot.Instance?.Flags?.SetFlag(picked.setsFlagOnPick, true);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(picked.targetNpcId) && picked.affinityDelta != 0)
                        GameRoot.Instance?.Relationships?.AddAffinity(picked.targetNpcId, picked.affinityDelta);

                    ApplyAssetRewards(asset);

                    if (picked.branchDialogue != null)
                    {
                        var cb = _onFinishCallback;
                        _activeAsset = null;
                        _onFinishCallback = null;
                        StartDialogue(picked.branchDialogue, cb);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                FinishDialogue(skipRewards: true);
            });
        }

        private void ResolvePortrait(string speaker, string speakerId, Sprite overrideSprite, out Sprite portrait, out bool alignLeft, out bool isFloating, out string voiceId)
        {
            portrait = overrideSprite;
            alignLeft = false;
            isFloating = false;
            voiceId = "";

            string key = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(speakerId)
                ? speakerId.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
                : (string.IsNullOrEmpty(speaker) ? "" : speaker.Trim().ToLowerInvariant());

            if (key == "none" || key.Contains("thư của bà"))
            {
                portrait = null;
                return;
            }
            if (key.Contains("wen"))
            {
                alignLeft = true; voiceId = "wen";
                if (portrait == null) portrait = portraitWen;
                return;
            }
            if (key.Contains("lumi"))
            {
                alignLeft = true; isFloating = true; voiceId = "lumi";
                if (portrait == null) portrait = portraitLumi;
                return;
            }
            if (key.Contains("bach") || key.Contains("bách"))
            {
                alignLeft = false; voiceId = "bach";
                if (portrait == null) portrait = portraitBach;
                return;
            }
            if (key.Contains("hana"))
            {
                alignLeft = false; voiceId = "hana";
                if (portrait == null) portrait = portraitHana;
                return;
            }
            if (key.Contains("toby"))
            {
                alignLeft = false; voiceId = "toby";
                if (portrait == null) portrait = portraitToby;
                return;
            }
            if (key.Contains("otis"))
            {
                alignLeft = false; voiceId = "otis";
                if (portrait == null) portrait = portraitOtis;
                return;
            }
        }

        private void ApplyAssetRewards(DialogueData asset)
        {
            if (asset == null || GameRoot.Instance == null) return;

            if (asset.consumesRequiredItem != null && asset.consumesAmount > 0)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Inventory?.RemoveItem(asset.consumesRequiredItem.itemID, asset.consumesAmount);
            }
            if (asset.givesItemOnFinish != null && asset.givesItemAmount > 0)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Inventory?.AddItem(asset.givesItemOnFinish, asset.givesItemAmount, true);
            }
            if (asset.extraRewards != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < asset.extraRewards.Count; i++)
                {
                    var r = asset.extraRewards[i];
                    if (r.item != null && r.amount > 0)
                    {
                        GameRoot.Instance.Inventory?.AddItem(r.item, r.amount, true);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (asset.unlocksDiaryPage != null)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Diary?.UnlockPage(asset.unlocksDiaryPage.pageID);
            }
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asset.setsStoryFlagOnFinish))
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Flags?.SetFlag(asset.setsStoryFlagOnFinish, true);
            }
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asset.affinityNpcId) && asset.affinityBonusOnFinish != 0)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.Relationships?.AddAffinity(asset.affinityNpcId, asset.affinityBonusOnFinish);
            }
        }

        private void FinishDialogue(bool skipRewards = false)
        {
            _isPlaying = false;
            if (dialogueUI != null) dialogueUI.Hide();

            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.State != null)
            {
                GameRoot.Instance.State.ReturnToGameplay();
            }

            if (!skipRewards && _activeAsset != null)
            {
                ApplyAssetRewards(_activeAsset);
            }

            var cb = _onFinishCallback;
            _activeAsset = null;
            _onFinishCallback = null;
            cb?.Invoke();
        }

        private string ResolveText(string key)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)) return string.Empty;
            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Loc != null)
            {
                string val = GameRoot.Instance.Loc.Get(key);
                if (!val.StartsWith("[")) return val;
            }
            return key;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Data;

namespace MoonpetalValley.Narrative
{
    public class DiaryManager : MonoBehaviour, ISaveable, IResettable
    {
        [SerializeField] private List<DiaryPageData> allPages = new List<DiaryPageData>();

        public event Action OnDiaryUpdated;
        private readonly HashSet<string> _unlockedPageIds = new HashSet<string>();

        public string SaveKey => "diary_pages";

        [Serializable]
        private class DiarySaveData
        {
            public List<string> unlockedIds = new List<string>();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnStoryFlagChanged += HandleStoryFlagChanged;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            GameEventBus.OnStoryFlagChanged -= HandleStoryFlagChanged;
        }

        private void HandleStoryFlagChanged(string flagId, bool value)
        {
            if (!value) return;
            for (int i = 0; i < allPages.Count; i++)
            {
                if (allPages[i] != null && allPages[i].unlockedByFlag == flagId)
                {
                    UnlockPage(allPages[i].pageID);
                }
            }
        }

        public void UnlockPage(string pageId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageId)) return;
            if (_unlockedPageIds.Add(pageId))
            {
                DiaryPageData page = GetPageById(pageId);
                int num = page != null ? page.pageNumber : _unlockedPageIds.Count;
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Đã mở khóa Sổ Tay Của Bà | Trang " + num + "! Bấm [B] để đọc.");
                OnDiaryUpdated?.Invoke();
            }
        }

        public bool HasPage(string pageId) => _unlockedPageIds.Contains(pageId);
        public int UnlockedCount => _unlockedPageIds.Count;
        public bool HasAllFourPages() => _unlockedPageIds.Count >= 4;

        public List<DiaryPageData> GetUnlockedPages()
        {
            var result = new List<DiaryPageData>();
            for (int i = 0; i < allPages.Count; i++)
            {
                if (allPages[i] != null && _unlockedPageIds.Contains(allPages[i].pageID))
                {
                    result.Add(allPages[i]);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        private DiaryPageData GetPageById(string pageId)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < allPages.Count; i++)
            {
                if (allPages[i] != null && allPages[i].pageID == pageId) return allPages[i];
            }
            return null;
        }

        public string CaptureStateJson()
        {
            return JsonUtility.ToJson(new DiarySaveData { unlockedIds = new List<string>(_unlockedPageIds) });
        }

        public void RestoreStateJson(string json)
        {
            _unlockedPageIds.Clear();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json)) return;
            var data = JsonUtility.FromJson<DiarySaveData>(json);
            if (data != null && data.unlockedIds != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < data.unlockedIds.Count; i++) _unlockedPageIds.Add(data.unlockedIds[i]);
            }
            OnDiaryUpdated?.Invoke();
        }
    
        public void ResetForNewGame()
        {
            _unlockedPageIds.Clear();
            OnDiaryUpdated?.Invoke();
        }
}
}
```

## 48. `Assets/Scripts/Narrative/IntroCutsceneManager.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;
using TMPro;
using MoonpetalValley.Core;
using MoonpetalValley.Player;
using MoonpetalValley.UI;
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
#endif

namespace MoonpetalValley.Narrative
{
    public class IntroCutsceneManager : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("UI References")]
        [SerializeField] private CanvasGroup cutsceneRootGroup;
        [SerializeField] private Image fadeOverlay;
        [SerializeField] private RectTransform topLetterbox;
        [SerializeField] private RectTransform bottomLetterbox;
        [SerializeField] private TMP_Text speakerText;
        [SerializeField] private TMP_Text subtitleText;
        [SerializeField] private CanvasGroup subtitleGroup;
        [SerializeField] private GameObject skipBarRoot;
        [SerializeField] private Image skipFillImage;
        [SerializeField] private TMP_Text skipHintText;
        [SerializeField] private TMP_Text continueHintText;

        [Header("Scene Targets")]
        [SerializeField] private Transform seedBoxTransform;
        [SerializeField] private float letterboxHeight = 96f;
        [SerializeField] private float skipHoldDuration = 1.2f;

        private bool _isPlaying;
        private bool _advanceRequested;
        private float _spaceHeldTime;
        private bool _spaceWasDown;
        private float _skipHoldTimer;
        private float _stepLockTimer;
        private Coroutine _playRoutine;
        private Coroutine _subtitleFadeRoutine;
        private CameraFollow2D _camFollow;
        private readonly List<CanvasGroup> _hiddenHudGroups = new List<CanvasGroup>();
        private Vector3 _seedBoxOriginalPos;
        private bool _hasSeedBoxPos;
        private SpriteRenderer _seedBoxGlowRenderer;

        private const float TAP_THRESHOLD = 0.28f;
        private const float HOLD_VISUAL_DELAY = 0.22f;

        public bool IsPlaying => _isPlaying;

        private void Start()
        {
            if (cutsceneRootGroup != null)
            {
                cutsceneRootGroup.alpha = 0f;
                cutsceneRootGroup.blocksRaycasts = false;
                cutsceneRootGroup.interactable = false;
            }
            if (skipBarRoot != null) skipBarRoot.SetActive(false);

            if (seedBoxTransform == null)
            {
                GameObject boxGo = GameObject.Find("GreenhouseSeedBox");
                if (boxGo != null) seedBoxTransform = boxGo.transform;
            }

            if (seedBoxTransform != null)
            {
                _seedBoxOriginalPos = seedBoxTransform.position;
                _hasSeedBoxPos = true;
            }

            if (SaveLoadManager.IsPendingLoad)
            {
                return;
            }

            StartCoroutine(CheckAndAutoPlayAfterLoad());
        }

        private IEnumerator CheckAndAutoPlayAfterLoad()
        {
            // Cho 2 frame de SaveLoadManager.DelayedLoadRoutine() hoan tat nap 100% file luu
            float _waitGuard = 0f;
            while (SaveLoadManager.IsPendingLoad && _waitGuard < 2.0f)
            {
                _waitGuard += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                yield return null;
            }
            if (SaveLoadManager.IsPendingLoad) yield break;
            if (ShouldAutoPlayIntro())
            {
                StartIntroCutscene();
            }
        }

        private bool ShouldAutoPlayIntro()
        {
            if (GameRoot.Instance == null || GameRoot.Instance.Flags == null) return false;
            var flags = GameRoot.Instance.Flags;
            if (flags.HasFlag("flag_intro_cutscene_done")) return false;
            if (flags.HasFlag("flag_intro_letter_read")) return false;
            if (flags.HasFlag("flag_greenhouse_cleared")) return false;
            if (flags.HasFlag("flag_lumi_awakened")) return false;
            if (flags.HasFlag("flag_tutorial_done")) return false;
            if (flags.HasFlag("flag_nv1_completed")) return false;
            return true;
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (Application.isEditor || Debug.isDebugBuild)
            {
                if (!_isPlaying && IsReplayHotkeyPressed() &&
                    GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.State != null &&
                    GameRoot.Instance.State.IsGameplayActive)
                {
                    StartIntroCutscene();
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (!_isPlaying) return;

            if (_stepLockTimer > 0f)
            {
                _stepLockTimer -= Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
            }

            if (continueHintText != null && continueHintText.gameObject.activeSelf)
            {
                float a = 0.45f + 0.35f * (0.5f + 0.5f * Mathf.Sin(Time.unscaledTime * 3.0f));
                Color c = continueHintText.color;
                c.a = a;
                continueHintText.color = c;
            }

            HandleCutsceneInput();
        }

        private void HandleCutsceneInput()
        {
            bool spaceHeld = IsSpaceHeld();
            bool escHeld = IsEscapeHeld();

            if (_stepLockTimer <= 0f && IsQuickAdvancePressed())
            {
                _advanceRequested = true;
            }

            if (spaceHeld)
            {
                _spaceWasDown = true;
                _spaceHeldTime += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
            }
            else if (_spaceWasDown)
            {
                if (_stepLockTimer <= 0f && _spaceHeldTime > 0f && _spaceHeldTime < TAP_THRESHOLD)
                {
                    _advanceRequested = true;
                }
                _spaceWasDown = false;
                _spaceHeldTime = 0f;
            }

            bool holdingSkip = escHeld || (spaceHeld && _spaceHeldTime >= HOLD_VISUAL_DELAY);
            if (holdingSkip)
            {
                _skipHoldTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                float effectiveDuration = Mathf.Max(0.25f, skipHoldDuration - (escHeld ? 0f : HOLD_VISUAL_DELAY));
                float pct = Mathf.Clamp01(_skipHoldTimer / effectiveDuration);
                if (skipBarRoot != null && !skipBarRoot.activeSelf) skipBarRoot.SetActive(true);
                if (skipFillImage != null) skipFillImage.fillAmount = pct;
                if (pct >= 1f)
                {
                    SkipCutsceneNow();
                }
            }
            else if (_skipHoldTimer > 0f)
            {
                _skipHoldTimer = Mathf.Max(0f, _skipHoldTimer - Time.unscaledDeltaTime * 3.0f);
                if (skipFillImage != null)
                {
                    skipFillImage.fillAmount = Mathf.Clamp01(_skipHoldTimer / Mathf.Max(0.25f, skipHoldDuration));
                }
                if (_skipHoldTimer <= 0.001f && skipBarRoot != null && skipBarRoot.activeSelf)
                {
                    skipBarRoot.SetActive(false);
                }
            }
        }

        public void StartIntroCutscene()
        {
            if (_isPlaying) return;
            _camFollow = UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<CameraFollow2D>();
            _isPlaying = true;
            _advanceRequested = false;
            _spaceWasDown = false;
            _spaceHeldTime = 0f;
            _skipHoldTimer = 0f;
            _stepLockTimer = 0.25f;

            if (skipFillImage != null) skipFillImage.fillAmount = 0f;
            if (skipBarRoot != null) skipBarRoot.SetActive(false);

            if (_playRoutine != null) StopCoroutine(_playRoutine);
            _playRoutine = StartCoroutine(PlayCutsceneRoutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator PlayCutsceneRoutine()
        {
            GameRoot.Instance?.State?.SetState(GameState.Cutscene);
            SetGameplayHudVisible(false);

            if (cutsceneRootGroup != null)
            {
                cutsceneRootGroup.alpha = 1f;
                cutsceneRootGroup.blocksRaycasts = true;
            }
            if (fadeOverlay != null) fadeOverlay.color = new Color(0.05f, 0.04f, 0.07f, 1f);
            if (skipHintText != null) skipHintText.text = "Giữ [Space] / [Esc] để bỏ qua";
            if (continueHintText != null)
            {
                continueHintText.text = "[Space] Tiếp tục";
                continueHintText.gameObject.SetActive(false);
            }
            SetSubtitle("", "");
            SetLetterboxImmediate(0f);

            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.BeginCutsceneOverride(new Vector3(0f, -10.0f, -10f), 6.2f);
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(0f, -1.2f, -10f), 5.6f, 0.35f);
            }

            StartCoroutine(AnimateLetterbox(0f, letterboxHeight, 0.65f));
            yield return FadeOverlayAlpha(1f, 0f, 1.3f);

            if (continueHintText != null) continueHintText.gameObject.SetActive(true);

            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Ba mùa thu trôi qua kể từ ngày bà mất. Tôi vẫn giữ chùm chìa khóa cũ của bà trong túi áo.");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(6.5f);

            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Thung lũng Moonpetal ngày xưa ngập hương hoa. Giờ chỉ còn làn sương tím ẩm lạnh phủ kín lối đi.");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(7.0f);

            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(1.5f, 4.5f, -10f), 5.5f, 0.85f);
            }
            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Lò bánh của bà Hana vẫn đỏ lửa mỗi sáng, nhưng chẳng còn mấy ai ghé ngang.");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(7.5f);

            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(10.0f, 6.2f, -10f), 5.4f, 0.80f);
            }
            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Khu vườn phía Nam đóng cổng đã lâu. Người ta bảo hoa Moonpetal đã tắt lịm cùng mùa đông năm ấy.");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(7.5f);

            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(-15.5f, 10.6f, -10f), 4.6f, 0.95f);
            }
            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Hôm qua, tôi nhận được phong thư viết sẵn của bà, gửi nhờ bác đưa thư Otis giữ suốt ba năm.");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(8.0f);

            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(-15.5f, 12.2f, -10f), 4.1f, 1.0f);
            }
            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Bà chỉ dặn một câu: 'Nếu con thấy mệt với phố thị, hãy về mở cửa nhà kính cũ.'");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(8.0f);

            Vector3 boxFocus = seedBoxTransform != null ? seedBoxTransform.position : new Vector3(-17.2f, 12.5f, 0f);
            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(boxFocus.x + 0.4f, boxFocus.y - 0.3f, -10f), 3.6f, 1.35f);
            }

            SetSubtitle("", "<i>Tiếng sột soạt khe khẽ vang lên từ chiếc hộp gỗ cũ trên kệ...</i>");
            yield return ShakeAndGlowSeedBoxOrAdvance(3.6f);

            GameRoot.Instance?.Audio?.PlayUIClick();
            SetSubtitle("???", "Khịt khịt... Mùi nắng mới? Hay là có người mở cửa nhà kính thật rồi?");
            yield return ShakeAndGlowSeedBoxOrAdvance(5.8f);

            SetSubtitle("Wen", "Khoan đã... Cái hộp gỗ của bà vừa rung lên sao?");
            yield return WaitOrAdvance(5.2f);

            if (continueHintText != null) continueHintText.gameObject.SetActive(false);

            Vector3 wenPos = new Vector3(-15.0f, 10.0f, 0f);
            var player = UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<PlayerController2D>();
            if (player != null) wenPos = player.transform.position;

            float baseOrtho = _camFollow != null ? _camFollow.DefaultOrthoSize : 5f;
            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.SetCutsceneTarget(new Vector3(wenPos.x, wenPos.y, -10f), baseOrtho, 2.0f);
            }
            SetSubtitle("", "");
            yield return AnimateLetterbox(letterboxHeight, 0f, 0.75f);
            yield return WaitUnscaled(0.4f);

            FinishCutscene(false);
        }

        private void SkipCutsceneNow()
        {
            if (!_isPlaying) return;
            if (_playRoutine != null)
            {
                StopCoroutine(_playRoutine);
                _playRoutine = null;
            }
            FinishCutscene(true);
        }

        private void FinishCutscene(bool wasSkipped)
        {
            _isPlaying = false;
            _advanceRequested = false;
            _spaceWasDown = false;
            _spaceHeldTime = 0f;
            _skipHoldTimer = 0f;
            RestoreSeedBoxVisual();

            if (_camFollow != null)
            {
                _camFollow.EndCutsceneOverride(wasSkipped);
            }

            SetSubtitle("", "");
            SetLetterboxImmediate(0f);
            if (skipBarRoot != null) skipBarRoot.SetActive(false);
            if (continueHintText != null) continueHintText.gameObject.SetActive(false);
            if (fadeOverlay != null) fadeOverlay.color = new Color(0.05f, 0.04f, 0.07f, 0f);
            if (cutsceneRootGroup != null)
            {
                cutsceneRootGroup.alpha = 0f;
                cutsceneRootGroup.blocksRaycasts = false;
            }

            SetGameplayHudVisible(true);

            GameRoot.Instance?.Flags?.SetFlag("flag_intro_cutscene_done", true);
            GameRoot.Instance?.State?.ReturnToGameplay();

            if (GameRoot.Instance != null && GameRoot.Instance.Flags != null &&
                !GameRoot.Instance.Flags.HasFlag("flag_intro_letter_read"))
            {
                GameEventBus.RaiseToastRequested("Chào mừng về Thung Lũng Moonpetal! Hãy đọc bức thư trên bàn gỗ [E].");
            }
        }

        private IEnumerator WaitOrAdvance(float seconds)
        {
            _advanceRequested = false;
            _stepLockTimer = 0.16f;
            float elapsed = 0f;
            while (elapsed < seconds)
            {
                if (_advanceRequested)
                {
                    _advanceRequested = false;
                    GameRoot.Instance?.Audio?.PlayUIClick();
                    yield break;
                }
                elapsed += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                yield return null;
            }
        }

        private IEnumerator ShakeAndGlowSeedBoxOrAdvance(float duration)
        {
            EnsureSeedBoxGlow();
            _advanceRequested = false;
            _stepLockTimer = 0.16f;
            float elapsed = 0f;
            while (elapsed < duration)
            {
                if (_advanceRequested)
                {
                    _advanceRequested = false;
                    GameRoot.Instance?.Audio?.PlayUIClick();
                    break;
                }
                elapsed += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                if (seedBoxTransform != null && _hasSeedBoxPos)
                {
                    float pulse = Mathf.Sin(elapsed * 28f) * 0.045f;
                    seedBoxTransform.position = _seedBoxOriginalPos + new Vector3(pulse, Mathf.Abs(pulse) * 0.4f, 0f);
                }
                if (_seedBoxGlowRenderer != null)
                {
                    _seedBoxGlowRenderer.enabled = true;
                    float a = 0.28f + Mathf.Sin(elapsed * 5.5f) * 0.16f;
                    _seedBoxGlowRenderer.color = new Color(0.68f, 0.88f, 1.0f, a);
                    float s = 1.35f + Mathf.Sin(elapsed * 4.2f) * 0.18f;
                    _seedBoxGlowRenderer.transform.localScale = new Vector3(s, s, 1f);
                }
                yield return null;
            }
            if (seedBoxTransform != null && _hasSeedBoxPos)
            {
                seedBoxTransform.position = _seedBoxOriginalPos;
            }
        }

        private void EnsureSeedBoxGlow()
        {
            if (_seedBoxGlowRenderer != null || seedBoxTransform == null) return;
            GameObject glowGo = new GameObject("CutsceneSeedBoxGlow");
            glowGo.transform.SetParent(seedBoxTransform, false);
            glowGo.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0.1f, 0f);

            var sr = glowGo.AddComponent<SpriteRenderer>();
            sr.sprite = CreateSoftGlowSprite();
            sr.sortingLayerName = "WeatherVFX";
            sr.sortingOrder = 15;
            sr.color = new Color(0.68f, 0.88f, 1.0f, 0f);
            _seedBoxGlowRenderer = sr;
        }

        private void RestoreSeedBoxVisual()
        {
            if (seedBoxTransform != null && _hasSeedBoxPos)
            {
                seedBoxTransform.position = _seedBoxOriginalPos;
            }
            if (_seedBoxGlowRenderer != null)
            {
                _seedBoxGlowRenderer.enabled = false;
            }
        }

        private Sprite CreateSoftGlowSprite()
        {
            const int size = 32;
            Texture2D tex = new Texture2D(size, size, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
            tex.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
            float half = (size - 1) * 0.5f;
            for (int y = 0; y < size; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < size; x++)
                {
                    float dx = (x - half) / half;
                    float dy = (y - half) / half;
                    float d = Mathf.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                    float a = Mathf.Clamp01(1f - d);
                    a = a * a;
                    tex.SetPixel(x, y, new Color(1f, 1f, 1f, a));
                }
            }
            tex.Apply();
            return Sprite.Create(tex, new Rect(0, 0, size, size), new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f), 16f);
        }

        private void SetGameplayHudVisible(bool visible)
        {
            if (!visible)
            {
                _hiddenHudGroups.Clear();
                string[] hudCanvasNames = { "ClockHUDCanvas", "StatsHUDCanvas", "HotbarCanvas", "QuestTrackerCanvas" };
                for (int i = 0; i < hudCanvasNames.Length; i++)
                {
                    GameObject go = GameObject.Find(hudCanvasNames[i]);
                    if (go == null) continue;
                    CanvasGroup cg = go.GetComponent<CanvasGroup>();
                    if (cg == null) cg = go.AddComponent<CanvasGroup>();
                    cg.alpha = 0f;
                    cg.interactable = false;
                    cg.blocksRaycasts = false;
                    _hiddenHudGroups.Add(cg);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _hiddenHudGroups.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (_hiddenHudGroups[i] == null) continue;
                    _hiddenHudGroups[i].alpha = 1f;
                    _hiddenHudGroups[i].interactable = true;
                    _hiddenHudGroups[i].blocksRaycasts = true;
                }
                _hiddenHudGroups.Clear();
            }
        }

        private void SetSubtitle(string speaker, string body)
        {
            if (speakerText != null)
            {
                speakerText.text = string.IsNullOrEmpty(speaker) ? "" : speaker;
                speakerText.gameObject.SetActive(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(speaker));
            }
            if (subtitleText != null)
            {
                subtitleText.text = body ?? "";
            }
            if (subtitleGroup != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(body))
            {
                if (_subtitleFadeRoutine != null) StopCoroutine(_subtitleFadeRoutine);
                _subtitleFadeRoutine = StartCoroutine(FadeSubtitleIn());
            }
        }

        private IEnumerator FadeSubtitleIn()
        {
            subtitleGroup.alpha = 0f;
            float t = 0f;
            while (t < 0.28f)
            {
                t += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                subtitleGroup.alpha = Mathf.Clamp01(t / 0.28f);
                yield return null;
            }
            subtitleGroup.alpha = 1f;
        }

        private void SetLetterboxImmediate(float height)
        {
            if (topLetterbox != null) topLetterbox.sizeDelta = new Vector2(0f, height);
            if (bottomLetterbox != null) bottomLetterbox.sizeDelta = new Vector2(0f, height);
        }

        private IEnumerator AnimateLetterbox(float fromH, float toH, float duration)
        {
            float t = 0f;
            while (t < duration)
            {
                t += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                float k = Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, Mathf.Clamp01(t / duration));
                SetLetterboxImmediate(Mathf.Lerp(fromH, toH, k));
                yield return null;
            }
            SetLetterboxImmediate(toH);
        }

        private IEnumerator FadeOverlayAlpha(float fromA, float toA, float duration)
        {
            if (fadeOverlay == null) yield break;
            float t = 0f;
            while (t < duration)
            {
                t += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                float a = Mathf.Lerp(fromA, toA, Mathf.Clamp01(t / duration));
                fadeOverlay.color = new Color(0.05f, 0.04f, 0.07f, a);
                yield return null;
            }
            fadeOverlay.color = new Color(0.05f, 0.04f, 0.07f, toA);
        }

        private IEnumerator WaitUnscaled(float seconds)
        {
            float elapsed = 0f;
            while (elapsed < seconds)
            {
                elapsed += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                yield return null;
            }
        }

        private bool IsSpaceHeld()
        {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
            if (Keyboard.current != null && Keyboard.current.spaceKey.isPressed) return true;
#endif
#if ENABLE_LEGACY_INPUT_MANAGER
            if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Space)) return true;
#endif
            return false;
        }

        private bool IsEscapeHeld()
        {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
            if (Keyboard.current != null && Keyboard.current.escapeKey.isPressed) return true;
#endif
#if ENABLE_LEGACY_INPUT_MANAGER
            if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Escape)) return true;
#endif
            return false;
        }

        private bool IsQuickAdvancePressed()
        {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
            if (Keyboard.current != null &&
                (Keyboard.current.eKey.wasPressedThisFrame || Keyboard.current.enterKey.wasPressedThisFrame))
                return true;
            if (Mouse.current != null && Mouse.current.leftButton.wasPressedThisFrame)
                return true;
#endif
#if ENABLE_LEGACY_INPUT_MANAGER
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.E) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Return) || Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0))
                return true;
#endif
            return false;
        }

        private bool IsReplayHotkeyPressed()
        {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
            if (Keyboard.current != null && Keyboard.current.f8Key.wasPressedThisFrame)
                return true;
#endif
#if ENABLE_LEGACY_INPUT_MANAGER
            if (Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.F8))
                return true;
#endif
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```
